Safety Precautions
A work permit must be issued, the qualified 
 maintenance staff should carry the suitable safety category.
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the work 
 area is required.
Wear your safety and healthy equipment as safety helmet, shoes.... etc.
Unit should be out of service.
Tools and Equipment
Suitable tool set.
Safety and healthy equipment as safety helmet, shoes.... etc
Work to be Carried Out
Check the halon 
 pressure.

 supply of the system
Disconnect the 
 discharge heads from all cylinders and clean
Disconnect the 
 solenoid valve assemblies from the cylinders
Weight each 
 cylinder (If at any time a cylinder shows a less in net weight it should be refilled or replaced )
Check the empty 
 and full weights of all cylinders are permanently stamped on the cylinders 
 valve bodies
Each time the 
 cylinders are weights( the date of weighting and the net weight should be 
 recorded on a tag attached to the cylinders )
Check the halon 
 pressure.
Return System to Service
Connect the discharge heads from all cylinders.
Connect the solenoid valve assemblies from the cylinders.
